title: Anthropic Upgrades AI Office Suite: From Brainstorming to Data Dashboards, Covering the Entire Team Collaboration Workflow
excerpt: As artificial intelligence evolves from standalone chat Q&A to deep office collaboration, AI company Anthropic recently rolled out a comprehensive upgrade to it
content_html:
As artificial intelligence evolves from standalone chat Q&A to deep office collaboration, AI company Anthropic recently rolled out a comprehensive upgrade to its AI office suite, launching a range of innovative features that cover the entire team collaboration workflow, aiming to truly turn its AI assistant into an efficient team collaboration workspace.

Three core new products launch together, connecting the full team collaboration chain

The core of this upgrade is the launch of three major products, fully covering teams' everyday office needs from idea generation to data analysis:

Claude Whiteboards: Designed for team brainstorming and planning, it lets users freely organize project plans and creative ideas on a digital whiteboard. This feature is currently in beta.

Claude Sheets: Focused on building and tracking spreadsheet data, it makes it easy for users to create various business trackers directly in spreadsheets. This feature is also in beta.

Claude Data: Renamed from Claude Dashboards and now officially launched. It can turn complex business data into shareable dashboards, data stories, or explainer videos with one click, making data presentation more intuitive and vivid.

Full-platform coverage and no repeated input, seamlessly integrating with third-party ecosystems

In terms of availability and interaction experience, these three new tools are now fully available to all paid plans and support synchronization across web, desktop, and mobile.

Through optimizations to the underlying architecture, these three tools can connect their collaboration workflows with one another, so users do not need to re-enter background information when switching between modules. At the same time, Anthropic has also upgraded its interactive connectors to support multiple third-party apps opening directly alongside Claude conversations. This makes it easier for users to carry out daily tasks and allows Claude to assist with changes at any time, further improving the team's overall collaboration efficiency.
